metadata.usage: Agents use this instead of reading binary images directly. Contains metadata for all sprites/assets.
metadata.vision_api_guidance: If agent needs to SEE the actual visual, use Gemini Vision or Claude Vision API. Provide file path: src/assets/ui/[filename].png

title_logo.purpose: Main menu title logo - 'Bloodmage 1995' retro style
title_logo.visual_description: Large retro-style text logo with bloody/crimson color scheme, reminiscent of 1995 Diablo. Contains ornate lettering.
title_logo.integration_notes: High-res UI element, renders as fullscreen title overlay

ui_plaque.visual_description: Stone/wood plaque with ornate borders. Dark background with carved edges. Used as modal/dialog background.
ui_plaque.integration_notes: Repeating/tiling pattern in corners and edges. Scales to dialog size.

ui_corner.visual_description: Ornate corner element with gargoyle/stone carving design. Used to decorate corners of UI panels.
ui_corner.integration_notes: Positioned at corners of dialogs/panels. 4-way rotatable.

ui_gem.visual_description: Gem-like circular indicator with gradient and shine. Represents player HP/Mana resource. Crimson/blood-red color.
ui_gem.integration_notes: Animates scale/pulse when player takes damage or gains mana. Used in both player stats display and hotbar.

ui_slider_cap.visual_description: Stone/metal circular cap with ornate design. Darkly styled to match UI theme.
ui_slider_cap.integration_notes: Draggable slider handle. Used for volume, brightness, difficulty sliders.

torch.visual_description: Animated torch with flame. Flickering orange/red color. Used as dungeon lighting source visual.
torch.integration_notes: Placed at light source locations. Works with Light2D system for dynamic lighting effects. Has flicker animation.

altar.purpose: Safe house altar - central hub decoration
altar.visual_description: Large ornate stone altar with dark mystical design. Featured in Safe House as central interactive element.
altar.integration_notes: Static decoration, interactive hotspot. Used for safe house ambiance.

rune_arch.visual_description: Tall stone archway with glowing runes carved into it. Purple/arcane glow. Mystical dungeon entrance.
rune_arch.integration_notes: Portal visual for dungeon entry. Works with Light2D for glow effects on runes.

gargoyle_top.visual_description: Stone gargoyle head/statue. Positioned at top of UI screens. Dark gothic aesthetic.
gargoyle_top.integration_notes: Non-interactive decoration. Positioned at screen top center.

gargoyle_bottom.visual_description: Stone gargoyle statue. Positioned at bottom of UI screens. Mirrors top gargoyle.
gargoyle_bottom.integration_notes: Non-interactive decoration. Positioned at screen bottom center. Vertical mirror of top gargoyle.

stone_tile.visual_description: Gray stone floor tiles with mortar lines. Repeating texture for dungeon ground.
stone_tile.integration_notes: Tiling texture. Used as base ground layer in dungeons. Procedurally applied to tilemap.

rock_tile.visual_description: Dark gray/brown rocky stone texture. Used for dungeon walls. Repeating tiling pattern.
rock_tile.integration_notes: Tiling texture. Applied to wall layers in procedural dungeon generation.

pending_sprites.comment: These sprites are referenced in assetManifest.json but not yet integrated (using procedural fallback)

integration_workflow.step_1_designer_creates: Designer creates sprite image (PNG/JPG) and saves to src/assets/[category]/[name].[ext]
integration_workflow.step_2_add_metadata: Add entry to this file (SPRITES_REGISTRY.json) with: file, size, dimensions, purpose, visual_description, used_in, integration_notes
integration_workflow.step_3_code_integration: Developer integrates sprite reference in code (e.g., ImageLoader, assetManifest.json)
integration_workflow.step_4_agent_context: When Agent needs to work with sprite: reads this JSON instead of binary image
integration_workflow.step_5_vision_if_needed: If Agent needs to SEE actual visual: use Gemini Vision API with file path

agent_guidelines.reading_sprites: ❌ DO NOT read binary image files. ✅ DO read this SPRITES_REGISTRY.json
agent_guidelines.visual_inspection: If you need to see actual sprite visual (for color matching, proportions, etc), REQUEST Gemini Vision API: 'Use Gemini Vision to inspect src/assets/ui/torch.png'
agent_guidelines.context_priority: Use visual_description field for understanding. Call Vision API only if description insufficient.
agent_guidelines.updating_registry: When integrating new sprite: update this file FIRST, then code. Commit both together.

common_tasks.adding_sprite: 1. Add JSON entry to SPRITES_REGISTRY.json 2. Use Gemini Vision to verify 3. Integrate in code 4. Commit both
common_tasks.modifying_sprite: 1. Update visual_description 2. Use Vision API to verify changes 3. Update integration_notes if needed
common_tasks.querying_sprite_info: Search this file for sprite name or ID. All metadata is here.

economy_notes.tokens_saved: Blocking binary images: 78,000 tokens (no agents read .png/.jpg files)
economy_notes.vision_api_cost: If agent needs Vision inspect: ~500 tokens per image (call on-demand, not per operation)
economy_notes.recommendation: Use this registry as primary source. Call Vision API only for visual decisions (colors, proportions, etc).
